scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aihub/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @aihub/server" "npm run dev -w @aihub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aihub/shared && npm run build -w @aihub/server && npm run build -w @aihub/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aihub/shared && npm run test -w @aihub/server && npm run test -w @aihub/relay && npm run test -w @aihub/web
